title: SimulatorDeviceMessage
description: Steel-factory simulator -> Azure IoT Hub device-to-cloud message. Device->cloud ONLY (Constitution IV: no reverse path). Payload telemetry MUST conform to telemetry-reading.schema.json and MUST carry origin='Synthetic' (Constitution IX).

deviceId.description: IoT Hub device identity (per-device key in Key Vault), e.g. 'sim-LU-BF1'.

readings.description: Batch of telemetry readings; each MUST have origin='Synthetic' and a sourceId identifying the simulator.

injectedScenario.description: Optional active failure-injection scenario id (e.g. 'degrading-furnace-LU-BF1') for deterministic replay/Independent Tests.

constraintSyntheticOrigin.description: Engineering rule (enforced by simulator + ingestion tests, not pure JSON Schema): every reading.origin MUST equal 'Synthetic'.
